semantic_seed.ace_symptom: Free Zone can preserve experiments and counterexamples, but its existing candidate set can become historical material without an explicit capability-to-question-to-revisit thread.
semantic_seed.counterexample_question: Can the same seed be repeatedly selected without new evidence, producing decorative learning records rather than a changed observation condition?
semantic_seed.extracted_mechanism: A long-lived learning system needs a capability map, bounded study atoms, deliberate re-observation after new evidence, and an experiment that can falsify whether the capability gap was reduced; a course directory is input provenance, not a completed skill or production authority.
semantic_seed.next_verification: At a future dedicated Free Zone shift, verify that the seed is handled only as sandbox material, that any resulting experiment retains this source hash, and that a later re-observation requires a distinct evidence change or preserved counterexample rather than daily repetition.
semantic_seed.transfer_hypothesis: If a Free Zone learning seed records one named capability gap, one falsifiable question, and one next verification, then repeated evening turns can revisit the gap when evidence changes without turning a course list or model-call quota into TaskPool work.
